kind.description: Who authored the entity: human, agent, migration (backfilled by kibi migrate) or import.

ref.description: Source reference for the authored content: URL, document path, ticket, commit or conversation id.

approved_by.description: The person who reviewed and approved this entity's content. Distinct from the requirement-level approved_by of an exception.

recorded_at.description: ISO-8601 time the provenance was recorded.
